question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Study of flying airplanes
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Aviation"** means the study or practice of flying airplanes. (विमानन)

 
 
• **Example:** He studied aviation to become a commercial pilot.
 
 
 
• **"Aviation"** refers to the designing, development, production, operation, and use of aircraft, especially heavier-than-air aircraft. (विमानन)
 
 
• **Example:** The aviation industry has seen rapid growth in the last decade.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Alchemy **(रसायन विद्या): A medieval forerunner of chemistry, concerned with the transmutation of matter.

 
 
• **Example:** Alchemy was once believed to be capable of turning base metals into gold.
 
 
 
• **Astronomy **(खगोल विज्ञान): The scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the universe as a whole.
 
 
• **Example:** Astronomy helps us understand the universe and our place in it.
 
 
 
• **Acoustics **(ध्वनिविज्ञान): The science concerned with the study of sound.
 
 
• **Example:** The acoustics of the concert hall enhance the musical experience.
